listing.summary: In that case, I can provide you with adequate substitute for your obsolete fleets in just ONE ship.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a massive capital ship with high armor, speed, and weapon capacity to serve as a powerful fleet substitute.

description:
In that case, I can provide you with adequate substitute for your obsolete fleets in just ONE ship.

I call it, BISMARCK.
- 1st grade armor n´ super-durable hull.
- Avesome maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18.
- Monstrously high flux capacity, 360° shield coverage.
- 100 fleet points, 5000 ordnance points limit (cca. 6500 with skills affection)
- Value 19 milion cr.
-17500 cargo, 5000 fuel
-Single flight deck

aiDescription: Provides a single heavy capital ship featuring 1st grade armor, super-durable hull, and over 200su speed. It includes monstrous flux capacity, 360° shield coverage, and extensive weapon mounts including small, medium, large, and missile slots. The ship has high fleet and ordnance point limits along with significant cargo and fuel storage.
